5254-5902-6797.easyPrerequisites: You control another creature with power 4 or greater.
5254-5902-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the creature with power 4 or greater.
When the creature dies, Warbeast of Gorgoroth triggers, creating a 0/0 Army creature token if you don't control one, then putting four +1/+1 counters on an Army you control.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Phantom Train and causing it to become a creature until end of turn
Repeat.

3817-3991-4247.description:
Cast Faceless Butcher by paying its mana cost.
When Faceless Butcher enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Sister Hospitaller.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Faceless Butcher.
When Faceless Butcher dies, its second ability triggers, returning Sister Hospitaller from exile to the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters, it triggers, returning Faceless Butcher from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Faceless Butcher enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Sister Hospitaller.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat from step 3.

requires.n: Gives +1/+1 counter to creatures that enter

3197-6797-6854--196.description:
Cast Herd Baloth by paying its mana cost.
When Herd Baloth enters, the effect that adds +1/+1 counters to entering creatures triggers or applies its replacement effect, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, that same effect causes you to place at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Host of the Hereafter triggers, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth
Repeat steps 3 and 4 once.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat from step 5.

2604-3532-5078-7811.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Iron Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

1172-5071.description:
Cast Channel by paying {G}{G}.
Activate the ability granted by Channel by paying 1 life, adding {C}.
Repeat step 2 as desired.
Cast Comet Storm by paying {R}{R} and all remaining available mana, dealing a large amount of damage to a set number of targets.
1172-5071.notes: The more life you have, the more damage you will deal. You can also add mana as desired from other sources to cast Comet Storm. Comet Storm's multikicker can be used to add targets as needed.

2034-5086-5183-6705-7743.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
2034-5086-5183-6705-7743.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Heroic Feast triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 1.

2092-6822-7426-7628.easyPrerequisites: There's a removable +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
2092-6822-7426-7628.description:
Activate Ray Fillet by paying {1} due to Agatha of the Vile Cauldron and removing a +1/+1 counter from a creature you control, causing you to draw a card.
Lyla triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Berta.
Berta triggers, adding {1}.
Repeat.

112-6259-7426.description:
Cast Clockspinning with buyback by paying {U} due to Samut, putting a +1/+1 counter on Berta and returning Clockspinning to your hand.
Berta triggers, adding {U}.
Repeat.

5195-6991-7431.description:
Cast Daydream by paying {W}, targeting Donnie & April
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve Daydream, blinking Donnie & April
When Donnie & April enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Daydream to your hand from your graveyard.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Repeat.

1628-2921-3490-7426.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Berta.
1628-2921-3490-7426.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Berta triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Berta and Animation Module trigger.
Resolve the Berta trigger, adding {1}.
Resolve the Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat

500-1181-3191-5361.description:
Cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying Auton Soldier and creating two token copies of it that are nonlegendary copies of Kairi.
When Auton Soldier dies, it triggers.
Holding priority, cast Sacrifice by paying {B} and sacrificing one of the Auton Soldier tokens.
When the token dies, it triggers. Choose either mode.
Resolve Sacrifice, adding six {B}.
Resolve the Auton Soldier trigger from step 5, causing you to mill six cards and return Saw in Half and Sacrifice from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat
500-1181-3191-5361.notes: You can forego casting Sacrifice if you have enough black mana. This'll allow you to net creature tokens. The additional Kairi trigger in step 4 can be used to put all instants and sorceries from your library and graveyard into your hand, or to bounce permanents.

5525-5702-6753.easyPrerequisites: You control a Forest that enters the battlefield untapped.
5525-5702-6753.description:
Animate a Forest that enters untapped using Llanowar Loamspeaker
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the animated Forest.
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
When the Forest tokens enter, Springheart Nantuko triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate the Forest tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
Repeat from step 4.

250-779-1168-1315-1479.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-779-1168-1315-1479.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, Toggo and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Zuran Orb by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Zuran Orb ability
Resolve the Toggo trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, Toggo triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

222-527-997-7060.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-997-7060.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Woe Strider twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

394-2034-5220-6441-6961.notablePrerequisites: You control ten or more lands that have different names.
394-2034-5220-6441-6961.description:
Activate Survey Mechan by sacrificing it.
When Survey Mechan dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Survey Mechan from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Desecrated Tomb triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Resolve the Survey Mechan ability, dealing 3 damage to any target and causing you to draw three cards and gain 3 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the two creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Survey Mechan by paying {4}.
Repeat.

3284-3490-4659.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing another creature you control, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Korvold's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and draw a card.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

1289-5078-5864-6766.notablePrerequisites: Birds of Paradise does not have summoning sickness.
1289-5078-5864-6766.description:
Activate Birds of Paradise by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Valley Floodcaller triggers, giving Birds, Otters, Frogs and Rats you control +1/+1 until end of turn and untapping them.
Repeat.

2558-3000-3698-5727.description:
Cast Sword of the Meek by paying {2}.
When Sword of the Meek enters the battlefield, The Prydwen and Grinding Station trigger.
Resolve the Grinding Station trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Resolve the Prydwen trigger, creating a 2/2 Human Knight and a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
When the Squirrel enters the battlefield, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Soldier.
Repeat from step 2.

1563-2457-4094-6633.easyPrerequisites: Kaya has at least two loyalty counters on it.
1563-2457-4094-6633.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate the Insects by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat from step 2

1617-3668-4831-4983-5358.notablePrerequisites:
You control a permanent that can tap to produce at least {G}.
Flesh Duplicate on the battlefield as a copy of Bellowing Aegisaur.
1617-3668-4831-4983-5358.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent you control by tapping it, adding at least {G}.
Activate Wayta by paying {G} and tapping it, causing Cacophodon and Bellowing Aegisaur to fight each other, with each only taking 1 damage due to Temple Altisaur.
Cacophodon and Bellowing Aegisaur trigger twice.
Resolve both Bellowing Aegisaur triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on each creature you control.
Resolve both Cacophodon triggers, untapping the mana-producing permanent and Wayta.
Repeat from step 2, alternating between having Cacophodon fight Bellowing Aegisaur and Flesh Duplicate to ensure neither dies due to lethal damage.

2382-2511-5659--33.notablePrerequisites: One Lhurgoyf must be on the battlefield, with the other exiled by Mimic Vat.
2382-2511-5659--33.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing a nontoken Lhurgoyf.
When the Lhurgoyf dies, Mimic Vat triggers, exiling the Lhurgoyf from your graveyard and returning the Lhurgoyf that was exiled to your graveyard.
Disa's first ability triggers, putting the Lhurgoyf from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

3000-5670-6097.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
3000-5670-6097.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature, creating a Treasure token and a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
When the Squirrel enters the battlefield, Hinterland Sanctifier triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

3197-5256-5445.easyPrerequisites: Tarrian's Soulcleaver attached to Herd Baloth.
3197-5256-5445.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
3197-5256-5445.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a 4/4 Beast creature token.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the Beast.
When the Beast dies, Tarrian's Soulcleaver triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a 4/4 Beast creature token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Repeat from step 3.

2167-5478-5531-5732.notablePrerequisites: You can produce at least {3}{U}{B}{B} between sacrificing lands excluding Port of Karfell to Squandered Resources and/or by tapping those lands for mana.
2167-5478-5531-5732.description:
If desired, activate any number of other mana-producing lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {1} for each land tapped this way.
Activate Squandered Resources by sacrificing a mana-producing land other than Port of Karfell, adding {U} or {B} if possible, or any other type of mana otherwise.
Repeat step 2 until you control no other mana-producing lands except Port of Karfell.
Activate Port of Karfell's second ability by paying {3}{U}{B}{B}, tapping and sacrificing it, causing you to mill four cards and return Lumra from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Lumra enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Lumra's enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Spelunking.
Repeat.

1850-2911-4543.description:
Activate Trench Behemoth by returning Graypelt Refuge from the battlefield to your hand, untapping it.
Play Graypelt Refuge, triggering it and Fastbond.
Resolve the Graypelt Refuge trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Fastbond trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Repeat.

4968-5136.notablePrerequisites:
Deathbringer Thoctar has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
Quietus Spike attached to Deathbringer Thoctar.
4968-5136.description:
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any creature an opponent controls.
The creature dies as a state-based action due to Deathbringer Thoctar's deathtouch.
Deathbringer Thoctar triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Repeat as desired.
You may also repeat this combo whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

2770-4691-5165.description:
Cast Donate by paying {2}{U}, giving an opponent control of Vilis.
During that player's next draw step, they draw a card.
Ob Nixilis triggers, dealing 1 damage to that opponent.
Vilis triggers, causing the opponent to draw a card.
Repeat from step 3.

283-1978-4201-4474-5077.notablePrerequisites:
Paradise Mantle attached to Scaretiller.
Illusionist's Bracers attached to Voltaic Construct.
Scaretiller does not have summoning sickness.
283-1978-4201-4474-5077.description:
Activate Scaretiller by tapping it, adding {1}.
Scaretiller triggers, returning Cabaretti Courtyard from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Cabaretti Courtyard enters the battlefield, causing you to sacrifice it and search your library for a basic Plains, Mountain or Forest and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, targeting Scaretiller.
Illusionist's Bracers triggers, copying Voltaic Construct's ability, targeting Scaretiller.
Resolve the copy of Voltaic Construct's ability, untapping Scaretiller.
Holding priority, repeat steps 1 through 3 one additional time.
Resolve the original Voltaic Construct's ability, untapping Scaretiller.
Repeat.

1082-3087-4465.description:
Cast Balthor by paying {2}{B}{B}.
Balthor enters the battlefield, triggering Dual Nature's first ability, creating a token copy of Balthor.
Put the nontoken Balthor into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Activate Basal Sliver by sacrificing it, adding {B}{B}.
Activate the token Balthor by paying {B}{B}{B} and exiling it, returning all black and red creature cards from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Balthor and Basal Sliver enter the battlefield, triggering Dual Nature's first ability twice.
Resolve the first Dual Nature trigger, creating a token copy of Basal Sliver.
Activate the token Basal Sliver by sacrificing it, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the second Dual Nature trigger, creating a token copy of Balthor.
Repeat from step 3.

2178-2837-5256-5309.notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Black Market Tycoon.
Black Market Tycoon does not have summoning sickness.
2178-2837-5256-5309.description:
Activate Black Market Tycoon by tapping it, creating either a 2/2 Cat or a 3/1 Dog creature token.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the Cat or Dog.
The Cat or Dog dies, triggering Black Market Tycoon, untapping Black Market Tycoon.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Repeat.

298-1887-4499-4929.description:
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Angelic Quartermaster.
Angelic Quartermaster enters the battlefield, putting two +1/+1 counters on Cryptic Trilobite and any other creature you control.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C} that can only be used to activate abilities.
Repeat.

uses.n: Halvar, God of Battle // Sword of the Realms

413-1069-3661-5222.description:
Cast Shield Sphere.
Untap Blasting Station.
Equip Sword of the Realms to Shield Sphere for {0}.
Activate Blasting Station, sacrificing Shield Sphere deal 1 damage to any target.
Sword of the Realms triggers, returning Shield Sphere to your hand.
Repeat.
